## Progress

- Added the axiom-free exact-carrier transport wrapper in [Pic0ExactCarrierProducer.lean](/home/axel/LeanAlgebraicGeometry-Horizon/MainProjects/Algebraic-Jacobian-Challenge-Rebuild/AlgebraicJacobian/Picard/Pic0ExactCarrierProducer.lean:36), committed as `e35957c4b3`.
- Exposed it from [AlgebraicJacobian.lean](/home/axel/LeanAlgebraicGeometry-Horizon/MainProjects/Algebraic-Jacobian-Challenge-Rebuild/AlgebraicJacobian.lean:819), committed as `a98646b8fa`.
- Persisted this run’s AJCR roadmap status and pinned-commit records as `850aabb1b8`.
- Focused and full `AlgebraicJacobian` builds passed. The wrapper has no project axioms; only standard Lean axioms were reported.
- Protections were acknowledged, task-started conversations were answered and archived, and the glued-comparison roadmap node was reconciled to `done`.

## Issues

- The requested finite-stage `RepresentableBy` producer is still missing. Existing results represent only the scalar extension to the separably closed field; no effective scheme/Yoneda descent constructs the exact finite-stage carrier.
- Exact-carrier projectivity/orbit-affineness, original-field Picard representability, and the PicRep/Jacobian/Challenge handoff therefore remain blocked. Existing `Challenge.lean` `sorry`s remain.
- LSP diagnostics remained `partial/still_elaborating` under shared-resource contention, and a cold kernel probe was stopped. No additional Lean check was run after the metadata-only roadmap commit.
- The worktree still contains unrelated/concurrent FormalizedSources changes, protected blueprint migration/deletions, references, and generated files. One AJCR parent roadmap file has an uncommitted formatting-only change; none of these were staged or reverted.

## Why I stopped

The objective is partly advanced but genuinely blocked by the absent same-carrier descent theorem. Marking the task complete would make an unsupported mathematical claim; `ajcr-complete` remains `blocked`.

## Next

Construct a natural Yoneda equivalence for `P.gluedOver` (or an effective scheme-descent theorem), then prove exact-carrier projectivity, apply finite Galois descent, and feed the resulting datum into the Jacobian headline. The detailed handoff is in [report.md](/home/axel/LeanAlgebraicGeometry-Horizon/.archon-horizon/runs/0202/sessions/0006-horizon-ajcr-complete/report.md).
